items.raw_excerpt: Dutch homes are famously charming – and famously awkward to furnish – for cabinetmakers at Cabinetheroes, that is the whole point. Narrow facades, steep staircases, and rooms that seem to defy right angles: these aren’t quirks, they’re history. Property taxes in many Dutch cities were once linked to the width of a building’s frontage, and the result can still be seen today: narrow hallways, steep staircases and rooms where standard furniture is difficult to place. The familiar hooks above many..
items.summary_en: Dutch homes are famously narrow, with steep stairs and odd angles. This is because old city taxes were based on how wide a building's front was. A cabinetmaker called Cabinetheroes says these quirks are history, and smart design can still make the space work.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 주택은 좁은 외벽과 가파른 계단, 부당한 각도의 방으로 유명하다. 옛날 네덜란드 도시의 재산세가 건물 정면 폭에 연동됐기 때문이다. 가구 제작사 Cabinetheroes는 이런 특징이 곧 역사라며, 똑똑한 설계로 공간을 충분히 활용할 수 있다고 말한다.
items.title_en: Sloped ceilings and narrow halls don't have to waste space
items.title_ko: 비스듬한 천장과 좁은 복도, 공간을 낭비할 필요는 없다
items.title_original: Sloped ceilings and narrow halls don’t have to waste space
